generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the climber base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the climber program gave as defaults until then.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Watson and Dallwitz's description of the family: the leaves are alternate, the lower ones sometimes opposite.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Watson and Dallwitz's description of the family: the leaves are usually distichous, in two ranks, otherwise spiral.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 202 Vitaceae: mostly shrubs climbing by tendrils, or small trees; leaves alternate (the lower ones sometimes opposite), simple or compound; flowers bisexual or of separate sexes on the same plant; fruit a berry, often juicy.
